collection.title: Infiniti Q QX30 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Infiniti QX30 2016 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this QX30 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below
